description: Rename a recording or rewrite its description. Renaming also stops Clipy's auto-titling from overwriting the name later. Pass description: null to clear it. Needs a key with recordings:write.

description.description: The new description, or null to clear it.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

name.description: The new title. Omit to leave the title alone.

name: update_recording
